sources.title: Study on Mechanical Properties of Tomatoes for the End-Effector Design of the Harvesting Robot
sources.notes: Primary modern experiment; Syngenta Sibede; 14 fruits per ripening group for physical parameters. Some reported height maxima are outliers/suspicious, so means/SD are preferred to raw max values.

sources.title: Physicochemical Properties and Respiration Rates of Tomato Cultivars (CV-613 and Naveen) at Different Maturity Stages
sources.notes: Thirty fruits used for dimensional measurements; fully-ripe true density 1000 kg/m^3 (Naveen) and 1040 kg/m^3 (cv.613). Table reports mean +/- SE.

sources.title: Evaluation of engineering properties for waste control of tomato during harvesting and postharvesting
sources.notes: Tomato-on-rubber static friction is not transferable to the deployed G20 pad. Use only for sensitivity/OOD reference.

sources.title: Design and simulation of a gripper structure of cluster tomato based on manual picking behavior
sources.notes: 200 Jiangshu No.1 tomatoes for geometry/grasp/rotation statistics; 50 best-picking-state tomatoes for pull after 360-degree rotation. Strong behavioral evidence, but cross-cultivar mechanical transfer remains medium confidence.

sources.title: Tomato Pedicel Physical Characterization for Fruit-Pedicel Separation Tomato Harvesting Robot
sources.notes: Syngenta Spectrum at early firm ripening. Axial tensile n=24 in three diameter groups; three-point bending span 12 mm. Distal/proximal shearing values are cutting-mode data, not direct abscission-zone shear strength.

sources.title: Studies of Torsional Resistance of a Tomato Peduncle
sources.venue: Bulletin of the Faculty of Agriculture, Shimane University
sources.notes: Older open-access study on H1370 and Chico. Valuable because direct tomato torsion measurements are scarce. Use broad ranges/qualification targets, not cultivar-specific nominal truth.

sources.title: Insights Into the Adaptation to Greenhouse Cultivation of the Traditional Mediterranean Long Shelf-Life Tomato Carrying the alc Mutation
sources.notes: Twelve long-shelf-life varieties. Greenhouse pedicel-length varietal mean range 2.92-3.88 cm; transfer as geometry randomization only.

sources.title: Experimental and theoretical analysis of fruit plucking patterns for robotic tomato harvesting
sources.notes: Strong support for combined loading and fatigue under reciprocating twisting; no fatigue exponent/time constant is treated as identified by this package.

sources.title: Structural Parameter Optimization of a Tomato Robotic Harvesting Arm: Considering Collision-Free Operation Requirements
sources.notes: 378 tomato bunches; categorical peduncle orientation distribution is directly usable in a world/task generator.

sources.title: Factors affecting human hand grasp type in tomato fruit-picking: A statistical investigation for ergonomic development of harvesting robot
sources.notes: Supports size-dependent grasp manifold/curriculum, not a robot joint-space calibration.

sources.title: Grasping behavior of the human hand during tomato picking
sources.notes: 60 greenhouse tomatoes, 16-channel e-glove. Distal thumb/index/middle pressure dominance and 0.26-1.56 s separation-stage duration are useful behavior priors.

sources.title: Mechanical properties of tomato exocarp, mesocarp and locular gel tissues
sources.notes: Layer-specific tissue properties; do not map directly to a rigid-body contact spring.

sources.title: An extended finite element model for fracture mechanical response of tomato fruit
sources.notes: Light-red JinshengF1; XFEM model validated against whole-fruit compression. Useful for future deformable/damage proxy, not direct G20 contact calibration.

sources.title: Factors that affect tomato bruise development as a result of mechanical impact
sources.notes: Uses impact classes 23, 71, 158, 216 mJ. Treat as OOD/damage evaluation metadata rather than a hard safe threshold.

grade_definition.A: direct primary experiment, closely matched quantity and clearly reported test
grade_definition.A-: direct primary experiment with cultivar/setup transfer caveat
grade_definition.B+: good primary evidence but mapping to current rigid-body simulator is indirect
grade_definition.B: direct evidence with substantial cultivar/environment or age/setup transfer uncertainty
grade_definition.B-: scarce/older direct evidence, retained as broad prior only
